preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c == '?' for c in S)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string S is either a lowercase English letter or a '?' character.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if not can_form_palindrome(S) else min_ascii_sum_of_differences(S)
postconditions.description: If it is not possible to make the string S a palindrome, return -1. Otherwise, return the minimum ASCII sum of the absolute differences of adjacent characters in the palindromic string.
